title: 第十五章 百姓偶遇妖兽拼尽全力仍无法战胜第十六章 屠狗只需一剑淡泊名利小仙师
slug: 看守废丹房三年我偷偷成仙了
lines: 筑基之后，秦凡已然脱去凡胎，实力完全不可同日而语。
只可惜，他现阶段没打算入内门，领不到圣地发放的内门奖励：一门神通级法术与一件上品法器。
也因此，他现在的实力，肯定弱于同境界的内门弟子。
这一点是些微的有些遗憾，可还好，他虽说领不到奖励，但他灵石够多。
在“钞能力”的加持之下，神通法术和法器都可以去坊市购买。
再加上，他突破不易，灵力比同境界弟子深厚，一旦法术和法器等外物跟上，实力在同境界内，怎么也能混个上等级别。
只不过，云谷坊市现在他肯定是不能再去了。
先前买卖一品丹药都被人给盯上了，要是再花上万灵石买法术和法器，那还不得让人给当韭菜嘎了？
“算算时间，也该去做任务了，正好，趁着这个外出的机会，去胥国走一趟，胥国的修仙坊市可比云谷坊市大多了，那里也没人能认出自己，查到自己来历，相对来说，比圣地要安全不少。”
打定了主意，于是秦凡决定去外门任务阁一趟，只是在出发前，还须得多炼制一些二品培元丹，用于日常修炼。
培元丹乃是天地灵气凝聚，辅以不同年份灵药炼制，从炼气期到渡劫期，都可助力平时修炼。
废丹房内的丹药，就数培元丹品阶齐全，从一品到八品，一应俱全。
要说为啥，倒也不是因为别的，纯粹是炼制此丹的修为门槛不高，灵药辅料也不算太珍贵，所以平时都由丹峰的弟子练手。
只要熟练了，有灵器辅助，炼气期都能炼八品的培元丹，区别只是成丹概率大还是小。
“筑基初期的妖丹在去凌霄阁前用筑基丹换了一百枚，但不必全用了，先炼个五十炉子，剩下的妖丹则留作备用。”
三天后，秦凡从废丹房离开，先是和孟祥辉打了个招呼，之后，这才去了外门地元峰的任务阁。
迈步进入任务阁大殿，殿内很是宽敞，按照任务等级，分为外门内门真传这三大区域。
也因此，殿内不光能看见外门弟子，还有许多内门弟子出入，有时运气好了，也能撞见真传中的金丹大修士。
殿内人声鼎沸，三五成群的站在墙壁与石柱前，对上面发布的任务议论指点。
墙壁与石柱都布置了阵法，青光闪烁，任务以文字的形式，在上面滚动展示，执事弟子也会每日以灵力将任务写上或删除，实时更新情况。
除此之外，任务也分重复接与不可重复接取、圣地管辖与非圣地管辖、外部委托与圣地发布等几大类。
每个任务的贡献值则是按照任务难度评估来判定，最低的，是十点贡献值，最高的，有上千贡献值。
秦凡可不打算玩高难度的，贡献值是好，可留在废丹房更重要，绝对不能引来圣地高层的注意。
“胥国，既然要去胥国，那就找圣地管辖这类的……”
“靠近胥国京城的……”
“还要不可重复接取的，以免和圣地同门碰上。”
秦凡站在人群外围，以筑基期神识扫榜，在外门任务区，没人能察觉到他的小动作。
就这样，扫了半刻钟之后，秦凡终于找到了条件合适的任务。
“圣地发布：胥国京城桃源县，有四级妖兽血尾狼出没，将其斩杀，取得完整妖丹，可得四十点贡献值，限期：一月之内，不可重复接取。”
就它了。
content_en:
After building the foundation, Qin Fan has shed his mortal body, and his strength is completely different.
It's a pity that he has no plans to enter the inner gate at this stage and cannot receive the inner gate reward issued by the Holy Land: a magical level spell and a high-grade magic weapon.
Therefore, his current strength is definitely weaker than the inner disciples of the same realm.
This is a little regretful, but fortunately, although he can't receive the reward, he has enough spiritual stones.
With the blessing of "money ability", magical powers, spells and magic weapons can be purchased in the market.
In addition, it is not easy for him to break through, and his spiritual power is deeper than that of disciples in the same realm. Once external objects such as spells and magic weapons catch up, how can he reach a higher level within the same realm of strength?
However, he definitely can't go to Yungufang City now.
The previous purchase and sale of first-class elixirs was targeted by others. If you spend tens of thousands of spirit stones to buy spells and magic weapons, then you are not allowed to be used as a leek?
"Calculating the time, it's time to do the mission. It just so happens that I take advantage of this opportunity to go to Xu Country. Xiuxianfang City in Xu Country is much larger than Yungufang City. No one there can recognize me. If I find out my origin, it is relatively safer than the Holy Land."
Having made up his mind, Qin Fan decided to go to the Outer Sect Mission Pavilion. However, before departure, he needed to refine some more second-grade Yuan Cui Dan for daily practice.
The Peiyuan Pill is a condensation of the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, supplemented by the refining of elixirs from different years. It can assist daily practice from the Qi refining period to the tribulation period.
The elixirs in the Wasted Alchemy Room include Peiyuan Dan, which has a complete range of grades, from the first to the eighth grade.
To say why, it's not because of anything else. It's simply that the threshold for refining this elixir is not high, and the elixir supplements are not too precious, so it is usually practiced by Danfeng's disciples.
As long as you are proficient and have the help of spiritual weapons, you can refine the eighth-grade Yuan Pei Dan during the Qi Refining Period. The only difference is whether the probability of becoming a pill is higher or lower.
"Before going to Lingxiao Pavilion, I exchanged the demon pills for a hundred for the foundation-building pills in the early stage of foundation building. But there is no need to use them all. I will make fifty furnaces first and keep the remaining demon pills for later use."
…
Three days later, Qin Fan left the Waste Alchemy Room. He first said hello to Meng Xianghui, and then went to the Mission Pavilion at Yuanfeng, the outer gate.
Stepping into the main hall of the Mission Pavilion, the hall is very spacious. According to the mission level, it is divided into three major areas: the outer door and the inner door.
Therefore, not only the outer sect disciples can be seen in the hall, but also many inner sect disciples coming in and out. Sometimes if you are lucky, you can bump into the golden elixir great monk in the true legend.
The hall was buzzing with people, standing in groups in front of the walls and stone pillars, discussing and giving advice on the tasks issued above.
Formations are arranged on the walls and stone pillars, green light flashes, and tasks are displayed on scroll in the form of text. The deacon disciples will also use their spiritual power to write or delete tasks every day, and the situation will be updated in real time.
In addition, tasks are also divided into several categories: repeatable and non-repeatable, holy land jurisdiction and non-holy land jurisdiction, external entrustment and holy land release, etc.
The contribution value of each task is determined based on the task difficulty assessment. The lowest is ten contribution points, and the highest has thousands of contribution points.
Qin Fan didn't intend to play high-difficulty games. The contribution value was good, but staying in the Wasted Alchemy Room was more important. He definitely couldn't attract the attention of the Holy Land's senior officials.
"Xuguo, since you are going to Xuguo, then find a holy land to govern this kind of thing..."
"Close to the capital of Xu Kingdom..."
"It must not be picked up repeatedly to avoid running into the same sect of the Holy Land."
Qin Fan stood outside the crowd and scanned the list with his foundation-building spiritual consciousness. No one in the outer mission area could detect his small movements.
In this way, after scanning for half an hour, Qin Fan finally found a mission with suitable conditions.
"Announcement from the Holy Land: In Taoyuan County, the capital of the Xu Kingdom, there is a level 4 monster called the Blood-Tailed Wolf. Kill it and get the complete demon elixir. You will get 40 contribution points. The deadline is: within one month. You cannot receive it repeatedly."
That's it.
